definitions.short: Shaphat , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H8202. Shaphat שָׁפָט proper name, masculine ( he hath judged ); — usually Σαφατ[θ] : 1 father of Elilsha 1Kin 19:16 , 19 ; 2Kin 3:11 ; 6:31 . 2 prince of Simeon Num 13:5 . 3 grandson of Zerubbabel 1Chr 3:22 . 4 Gaddite chief 1Chr 5:12 ( Σαβατ , Σαφαμ [ν] ). 5 herdsman of David 1Chr 27:29 ( Σωφαν , A Σωφατ , ᵐ5 L Σαφατ ).
